/*
*****
********** Welcome Message
*****
*/

.warning-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background-color: #f8c38b;  /* Muted orange color */
  color: #5a3d28;  /* Dark brown text color for contrast */
  padding-top: 15px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-image: linear-gradient(45deg, #f8c38b, #e57373, #f8c38b, #ffb74d); 
  border-image-slice: 1;
  animation: border-shift 3s linear infinite;
}

.warning-message {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 18px;
}

/*
*****
********** Welcome Message
*****
*/

.welcome-msg {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 150%;
  color: darkorange;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: unhide 4s linear 2s;
  animation-fill-mode: both;
}

.welcome-text {
  animation: color-change-d 6s ease-in-out 10s infinite alternate;  
}

/*
*****
********** Tabber
*****
*/

.wds-tabs {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  height: 40px;
}

tabber > .wds-tab__content.wds-is-current {
    background-image: url('https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/jaypersonaltesting/images/3/31/Zk7zqccdfjo71.png/revision/latest');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    color: #e0e0e0;
    padding: 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.2);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 0;
}


tabber > .wds-tab__content.wds-is-current::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); /* Adjust opacity for dimming */
    border-radius: 8px;
    z-index: -1;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab {
    background-color: #2b2323; /* Darker tab background */
    color: #b0b0b0; /* Muted grey */
    border-radius: 5px;
    margin: 0 5px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab > .wds-tabs__tab-label {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-variant: small-caps;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab:hover {
    background-color: #3e2a2a;
    border-color: #ff7f00; /* Muted dark orange */
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab > .wds-tabs__tab-label:hover {
    color: #ff7f00;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab:active {
    background-color: #2a2525;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.4);
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab > .wds-tabs__tab-label:active {
    color: #ff9f4d;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab.wds-is-current {
    background-color: #f5bc84;
    border-color: #ff7f00;
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab.wds-is-current:hover {
    background-color: #3e4e5d;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 140, 0, 1);
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__tab.wds-is-current:active {
    background-color: #2b3a4d;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.6);
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__arrow-right,
.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__arrow-left {
    color: #ff7f00;
    font-size: 20px;
    padding: 10px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__arrow-right:hover,
.tabber > .wds-tabs__wrapper > .wds-tabs > .wds-tabs__arrow-left:hover {
    color: #ff9f4d;
    transform: scale(1.2);
}

/*
*****
********** Table
*****
*/

table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    background-color: #2e2a2a; /* Muted dark background */
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.5);
}

th, td {
    padding: 12px 18px;
    text-align: center;
    border: 1px solid #3e3535; /* Slightly lighter border */
    color: #fff;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

th {
    background-color: #2b2323; /* Muted darker header background */
    font-weight: bold;
    font-variant: small-caps;
}

tr:nth-child(even) {
    background-color: #3e3535; /* Slightly lighter background for even rows */
}

tr:nth-child(odd) {
    background-color: #2a2323; /* Muted darker background for odd rows */
}

tr:hover {
    background-color: #3e3535;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
}

td:hover {
    background-color: #3e3535;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 5px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
    color: #fff;
}

th:hover {
    background-color: #2a3f4f;
    color: #ff7f00;
}

tr:active {
    background-color: #2b3a4d;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.4);
}

th:active, td:active {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.4);
    color: #ff9f4d;
}

tfoot {
    background-color: #2b2323;
    color: #ff7f00;
    font-weight: bold;
}

tfoot td {
    text-align: left;
    padding-left: 20px;
}

thead th {
    background-color: #2a3f4f;
    color: #ffffff;
}

thead th:hover {
    background-color: #3e3535;
    color: #ff7f00;
}

/*
*****
********** Img
*****
*/

img {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 10px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

img:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

img:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.3);
}

img[alt="futuristic"] {
    border: 3px solid #ff7f00;
}

img[alt="futuristic"]:hover {
    border-color: #ff9f4d;
}

img[alt="futuristic"]:active {
    border-color: #ff9f4d;
}

.img-container {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 15px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 5px;
    background-color: #2e2a2a;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.6);
}

.img-container:hover {
    background-color: #3e3535;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.3);
}

.img-container:active {
    background-color: #2b3a4d;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.3);
}

/*
*****
********** Link
*****
*/

a.new {
   color: red !important;
}

.wds-tab__content a {
    color: #ff7f00;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.wds-tab__content a:hover {
    color: #ff9f4d;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 1);
}

.wds-tab__content a:active {
    color: #ff9f4d;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.6);
}

.wds-tab__content a:focus {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
}

.wds-tab__content a::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: #ff7f00;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.wds-tab__content a:hover::before {
    transform: scaleX(1);
}

.wds-tab__content a[role="button"] {
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 5px 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background-color: #2e2a2a;
    color: #ff7f00;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.wds-tab__content a[role="button"]:hover {
    background-color: #3e3535;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.8);
    color: #ff9f4d;
}

.wds-tab__content a[role="button"]:active {
    background-color: #2a3f4f;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.6);
}

/*
*****
********** HR
*****
*/

hr {
    border: 0;
    height: 3px;
    background: #ff7f00;
    position: relative;
    margin: 20px 0;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.6);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

hr::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: #ff9f4d;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

hr:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 140, 0, 1);
}

hr:hover::before {
    transform: scaleX(1);
}

/*
*****
********** Animations
*****
*/

@keyframes color-change-d {
  from { color: gold; }
  to   { color: darkorange; }
}

@keyframes unhide {
  from { opacity: 0.3; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes border-shift {
  0% {
    border-image-source: linear-gradient(45deg, #f8c38b, #e57373, #f8c38b, #ffb74d);
  }
  50% {
    border-image-source: linear-gradient(45deg, #ffb74d, #f8c38b, #ffb74d, #e57373);
  }
  100% {
    border-image-source: linear-gradient(45deg, #f8c38b, #e57373, #f8c38b, #ffb74d);
  }
}
